content:
I tried to isolate the howl and remove the background noise but it destroyed the overall audio so I left the original file and amplified it.

A listener writes “We are from a small town called Marion in Northern Michigan. Last fall we were hunting together on his grandparents property when we heard this noise. We have heard many episodes featuring the Ohio howl and when I heard it on your show it gave me the chills.

We were hoping to get your opinion on the video to see if you think this is a creature howl or anything else. It plays about 40ish seconds in. It is a little hard to hear but if you put the audio near your ears you can hear it.

My husband hunts alone often near this property and has heard this before there. We have never had any encounters, just hearing the howling.”
